scope: Original ALERT, CONFIRM and Request windows in a standalone project with only the native plugin installed; no component, host method or replacement form

environment.compiler: 4D Server 20.8 Compile project, arm64_macOS_lib and x86_64_generic

pixelBaseline: Each AX run compares every window, active and before any action, with the same window from the plugin-free project; all report zero changed pixels.

observations: On the first keystroke into an initially empty Request field VoiceOver says "selection replaced" before the character, although nothing was selected.
notPassed: 4D Server and remote clients are not exercised by this record.
The Request caret is inferred from edits; Left/Right and mouse caret moves inside the field are not reported.
4D's own empty window-title text element remains beside the published elements.
Long, wrapped and localized messages and other built-in windows (DISPLAY SELECTION, file and print dialogs) are separate work.
